title: Revised cancellation charges for AC Two Tier and First AC

sections.text: Effective from 2026-11-01, the flat cancellation charge for AC Two Tier (2A) is reduced from Rs 240 to Rs 200. The flat cancellation charge for First AC (1A) is reduced from Rs 300 to Rs 260, while all other class charges remain unchanged.

For confirmed or RAC passengers, cancellations made more than 48 hours before departure attract a flat charge of Rs 120 for SL, Rs 180 for 3A, Rs 200 for 2A, Rs 260 for 1A and Rs 90 for CC. Cancellations made more than 12 hours and up to 48 hours before departure will incur a charge of 25% of the fare, but not less than the applicable flat charge. Cancellations made more than 4 hours and up to 12 hours before departure will incur a charge of 50% of the fare, but not less than the applicable flat charge. Cancellations made 4 hours or less before departure (after the chart) will not be refunded.

title: Revision of the Sleeper class Tatkal charge

sections.text: With effect from 2026-10-01, the Tatkal charge per passenger is SL Rs 175 (earlier Rs 150), 3A Rs 300, and 2A Rs 400. These charges apply to all Tatkal bookings in Sleeper, AC 3 Tier and AC 2 Tier classes.

Effective from 2026-12-15, the flat cancellation charges per confirmed or RAC passenger are: SL Rs 100, 3A Rs 160, 2A Rs 200, 1A Rs 260, CC Rs 80 if you cancel more than 48 hours before departure. If you cancel more than 12 hours and up to 48 hours before departure, the charge will be 25% of the fare, but it will not be less than the flat charge mentioned above. If you cancel more than 4 hours and up to 12 hours before departure, the charge will be 50% of the fare, but it will not be less than the flat charge, and if you cancel 4 hours or less before departure (after the chart), no refund will be given. Note that "More than N hours" is strict, so cancelling exactly N hours before departure falls in the next, costlier band.

For the festival season Ujjwal Rail runs the following special trains: 01001 South Central Special LTT to NGP (runs on Sun), 02002 Winter Festival Special CSMT to NGP (runs on Fri, Sat), 01123 Agra Delhi Special AGC to DLI (runs on Mon, Sun), and 02020 Delhi-Nashik Special NDLS to CSMT (runs on Sat).
Normal booking, cancellation and refund rules apply to special trains. Tatkal is not available on specials.

title: Fog season: delays and late-train refunds

sections.text: From December to February trains on the Delhi routes (NDLS, DLI) may run late because of fog. Passengers should check the train status before leaving home.
The late-train rule still applies: if the train departs more than 3 hours late and you do not travel, file a TDR before departure for a full refund.
